programs.title: Ax Men
programs.desc: As a storm closes in on the Oregon coast, the Ax Men race to stay one step ahead. Jesse continues to push the J.M. Browning crew to meet its looming deadline, while muddy roads trap trucks on their way to the Stump Branch site. Robby battles for control of the Gustafson crew. Pihl Logging feels the effects of the slumping lumber market.

programs.title: Mark Berg's Fishing Addiction
programs.desc: Fishing expert Mark Berg visits some of the best fishing destinations around. Chasing a wide variety of fish, Mark is always hoping to capture a new species or develop a new technique.

programs.title: Merv Hughes Fishing
programs.desc: Merv Hughes Fishing is a light hearted fishing show with some ripping catches, a few yarns (mostly true), mateship and of course a splash of comedy thrown in.

programs.title: Creek To Coast
programs.desc: We visit Leslie Dam, west of Warwick. Heading out for a family day on the water? Chris has the tips to keep you safe. Scott visits the brand new BCF Superstore in Mackay.

programs.title: Caught On Dashcam
programs.desc: From crazed drivers and ferocious tornadoes to out-of-control driverless cars - join us for a brand-new episode of Caught on Dashcam!
